findings.message: fig-U2-5 (Rest four-component flowchart, the primary schematic of load-bearing Topic 2.3 / U2-10) superposes two failure-branch labels in both English theme variants: "was outweighed" (x 488.0-585.6, left-aligned at x=488) prints over "did not follow through" (x 467.8-600.0, right-aligned at x=600) on the same baseline band y 139-153 of static/img/figures/efmp-302/unit-02/fig-U2-5.svg and fig-U2-5.dark.svg - 97.6x14 bounding-box overlap with 281 and 270 shared ink pixels (logs-feat023-r2/fig-U2-5-collision-detail.json; 4x crops under renders-feat023-r2/). A learner cannot read which failure belongs to the motivation branch and which to the character branch, and the alt text names the components but not the four failure labels, so the figure meaning is not fully recoverable. The current bytes are identical to the original figure-render commit 96dcf38, so this is pre-existing authoring damage, not a b8f8ffe or repair regression; it was invisible to check:figures (no glyph geometry), measure-figure-text (viewBox and wordmark only) and the cycle-1 review, which did not measure figure-internal text geometry (specs/gaps.md G-2026-62). Repair request: reposition or rewrap the two labels so their ink is disjoint (for example right-align "was outweighed" clear of x=470, move it left toward its branch line at x=480, or break "did not follow through" onto two lines), then re-run renders-feat023-r2/figure-text-overlap.mjs over the repaired variants and confirm zero shared ink. The Urdu variants are unaffected; no other figure in the unit collides.
